summary: Verified CrewBankModal portal fix on /events. Modal renders as direct child of <body> via createPortal, fully covers viewport (top=0,left=0,w=vw,h=vh) regardless of card position or ancestor hover:-translate-y-1 transform. All open/close and state-reset flows work. Backend regression: 6/6 routers 200.
critical_code_review_comments: CrewBankModal.jsx correctly gates DOM with `if (!open) return null` before portal creation - avoids SSR/mount issues.
Escape key + backdrop click both close; click inside white card is stopPropagation'd - all confirmed.
test_credentials: anonymous browsing (no auth needed for this fix verification)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal fix verified. Modal's parentElement === document.body on multiple event cards (first card 'Race Week Bellingham' and last card 'OCSA - Tropical Party'). Rect always {0,0,vw,vh}. Hover on parent <article> before/after opening does NOT reposition or hide the modal. Body scroll lock 'hidden' active while open, restored on close. Backend routers /api/events, /api/boat-pros, /api/crew-bank/open, /api/markets, /api/posts, /api/payments/packages all returned 200 via in-browser fetch (external curl gets 403 due to preview UA gate - not a real issue).
